name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.ExposedRoot.uncovered_readings_collide
title: Uncovered zero flip is detectable: below a zero entry of the only slot, two exposed readings differ by R1 (E0 - E1) + e1 (D20 - D21), which is short
statement: For matrices over a ring, if Rv * D1 = R1 * Am1 + e1, Am1 * D20 = R2 * Am2 + E0 and Am1 * D21 = R2 * Am2 + E1, then Rv * D1 * D20 - Rv * D1 * D21 = R1 * (E0 - E1) + e1 * (D20 - D21).
